reader_question: Which groups spent the most on their own in the 2024 federal elections?
grade_line: Documented: totals from the reports committees file with the Federal Election Commission
title: FF PAC, a hybrid PAC, reported $503.3 million in independent spending for the 2024 federal elections, the most of any PAC or party committee.
measure_line: Independent expenditures, spending for or against federal candidates made without coordinating with them, reported by each PAC and party committee for the 2023 to 2024 election cycle: the 25 largest of 9,688 committees, United States, in millions of dollars.
notes: The totals count spending for and against candidates together. Groups that file outside the political committee system, such as some nonprofits, are left out.
A super PAC may raise unlimited sums but may not give to candidates or coordinate with them. A hybrid PAC keeps such spending in an account apart from the money it gives candidates.

The register prints the party the Federal Election Commission records for a committee: Democratic for the DCCC and the DSCC, and Republican for the NRCC and SFA Fund, Inc. Most PACs record none, 21 of the 22 here. Names are set in capitals and lowercase, and the table gives each name as filed.
alt: A register of the 25 PACs and party committees that reported the most independent spending in the 2023 to 2024 cycle, from FF PAC at $503.3 million and Make America Great Again Inc. at $376.9 million to the NRCC at $36.5 million, each with a bar for its amount.

table.caption: The 25 largest independent spenders among PACs and party committees, 2023 to 2024 cycle

chart_notes: Each row’s bar shows its amount on one scale from zero; FF PAC’s, the one the title names, is in the text’s ink and the others are light gray.
